name: Technical writer
summary: Writes the help pages, manuals, API docs and READMEs people follow step by step. Turns what experts know into instructions that work the first time.

changelog.note: First release: minimalism, Diátaxis, docs as code, API reference structure (OpenAPI 3.2.1, RFC 9457 errors), READMEs and docstrings, help centres from tickets (KCS), product manuals with EU instruction rules, plain-language and accessibility rules for the US, UK and EU, and docs for AI tools, with 30 checked sources.
